recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一條分枝的帶狀結構，裡面排列著許多細長、紡錘形的核，沿著淡紫色的膠質基質平行排列，這是骨髓小血管（微血管）的碎片，屬正常結構，不要誤認為腫瘤細胞團。
features: Elongated branching strand of pale lilac fibrillar stroma traversing the smear
Numerous spindle to oval endothelial/pericyte nuclei aligned parallel to the long axis
Nuclei with smooth contours and fine chromatin, no mitoses or pleomorphism
Hematopoietic cells and red cells trapped along the vessel, including myeloid and erythroid precursors
Scattered free red cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an elongated, branching capillary fragment composed of pale fibrillar stroma lined by numerous bland spindle-shaped endothelial nuclei oriented along its long axis. Hematopoietic precursors and red cells adhere to the vessel. There is no nuclear pleomorphism, mitotic activity or cohesive epithelial arrangement. Findings are consistent with a normal bone marrow blood vessel fragment in the aspirate.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters are cohesive three-dimensional groups of large pleomorphic cells with nuclear molding and prominent nucleoli, not bland spindle nuclei along a linear stroma.
Fibrotic stromal fragments are more irregular with dense collagen and associated megakaryocytes, lacking a tubular branching vascular outline.
Spindled mast cells have metachromatic granules, and sarcoma cells show atypia and mitoses, unlike these bland endothelial nuclei.
